generic_domain.justification: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) are a broader category that includes various types of neural networks, including ReLU networks. While ReLU functions are commonly used within CNNs to introduce non-linearity, the concept of CNNs itself encompasses not just activation functions but also convolution layers, pooling, and other architectural elements. Therefore, 'convolutional neural networks' is more generic because it provides a comprehensive framework that can include and extend beyond specific types like ReLU networks.
